s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic painful intertriginous wounds with granulomatous inflammation
salient_findings: Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques
Granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate with well-formed, nonnecrotizing granulomas
key_facts: Multiple hospital admissions for cellulitis around the wounds
Received diverting sigmoid colostomy and indwelling urinary catheter
Wound care required nursing home care
Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques in intertriginous areas
Superficial and deep granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate on histopathology

shortlist.label: Crohn's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and elevated immunoglobulin G antibodies

shortlist.label: Pyoderma gangrenosum
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic painful intertriginous wounds with pseudoepitheliomatous epidermal hyperplasia

shortlist.label: Hidradenitis suppurativa
shortlist.why_kept: Linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques in intertriginous areas

shortlist.label: Granuloma inguinale
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and presence of Langhans-type multinucleated giant cells

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of painful intertriginous wounds with linear moist, eroded, exophytic, condyloma-like plaques, and the histopathological findings of pseudoepitheliomatous epidermal hyperplasia and granulomatous inflammatory infiltrate are consistent with pyoderma gangrenosum. The lack of response to adalimumab and the presence of a family history of a similar condition also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Crohn's disease
rejected.why: The patient's imaging studies, including computed tomography enterography, upper endoscopy, and colonoscopy, were unremarkable, which makes Crohn's disease less likely.

rejected.label: Hidradenitis suppurativa
rejected.why: While hidradenitis suppurativa can present with painful intertriginous lesions, the patient's histopathological findings and the presence of granulomatous inflammation are not typical of this condition.

rejected.label: Granuloma inguinale
rejected.why: The patient's lack of response to antibiotics and the presence of granulomatous inflammation on histopathology make granuloma inguinale less likely.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: While sarcoidosis can present with granulomatous inflammation, the patient's clinical presentation and histopathological findings are not consistent with this diagnosis.
